sections.Profile:
Players work through all eight Harry Potter films in a single game, from the first letter arriving to the final duel, with a moving Grand Staircase sculpture and a Quidditch upper playfield routing the ball. Designed by Eric Meunier, this licensed game carries film clips and music from the series, with sound work by David Thiel.
